concept_decisions: Retain concept folded central laminated interval and orderly bounding strata. Simplify many micro-laminae to14 unequal visually readable sediment bands across central and bounding intervals. One asymmetric fold with stronger rounded hinge, subordinate opposite bend; deformation tapers towards lower and upper orderly beds. Upper truncation separates contorted interval from flatter overburden. Single closed outcrop surface with physically differential erosion tied to sediment coordinates; no parallel floating ribbons, plates or overlapping cliff skins. Irregular broken top and ends, not perfectly rectangular educational cube.
